source_text: 大运河(Grand Canal)是世界上最长的人工河，北起北京，南至杭州。它是中国历史上最 宏伟的工程之一。大运河始建于公元前4 世纪，公元13 世纪末建成。修建之初是为了运输粮 食，后来也用于运输其他商品。大运河沿线区域逐渐发展成为中国的工商业中心。长久以来， 大运河对中国的经济发展发挥了重要作用，有力地促进了南北地区之间的人员往来和文化交 流。
reference_translation: The Grand Canal is the longest artificial river in the world, starting from Beijing in the north and ending in Hangzhou in the south. It is one of the most magnificent projects in Chinese history. The construction of the Grand Canal began in the 4th century BC and was completed at the end of the 13th century AD. At first, it was built for transporting grain, and later it was also used for transporting other goods. The areas along the Grand Canal gradually developed into China's industrial and commercial centers. For a long time, the Grand Canal has played an important role in China's economic development and effectively promoted the exchanges of people and cultures between the northern and southern regions.
